title: 7,000 實用英語單字清單（CEFR A1–B1）
section: 第 1,201–1,250 個單字（CEFR A2 初級）

examples.en: Many families spend hot summer weekends at the air-conditioned mall.
examples.zh: 許多家庭在炎炎夏日的週末會去有冷氣的購物中心吹冷氣逛街。

examples.en: The new suburban mall has over two hundred retail shops and an ice rink.
examples.zh: 這座新郊區購物中心擁有兩百多家零售店面和一座溜冰場。

examples.en: We met up at the central fountain of the shopping mall.
examples.zh: 我們在購物中心的中庭噴水池碰面集合。

examples.en: Mitsukoshi is a famous department store chain in Taiwan.
examples.zh: 新光三越是台灣知名的連鎖百貨公司。

examples.en: We bought high-quality kitchenware on the eighth floor of the department store.
examples.zh: 我們在百貨公司的八樓買了高品質的廚房用品。

examples.en: The department store was packed with shoppers during the anniversary sale.
examples.zh: 週年慶特賣期間百貨公司擠滿了購物人潮。

words.definition: 暢貨中心；暢貨門市；插座

examples.en: You can buy branded clothing at discount prices in the outlet.
examples.zh: 你可以在暢貨中心以折扣價買到名牌服飾。

examples.en: Don't overload the electrical outlet with too many high-power appliances.
examples.zh: 切勿在電源插座上插上過多高功率家電以免負載過重。

examples.en: The sports outlet mall is located just twenty minutes from the airport.
examples.zh: 這座運動品牌暢貨中心距離機場僅二十分鐘車程。

examples.en: She loves browsing stylish dresses in local fashion boutiques.
examples.zh: 她喜歡在當地的時尚精品小店瀏覽各式漂亮洋裝。

examples.en: The quaint boutique hotel offers personalized services for every guest.
examples.zh: 這家古雅的精品特色飯店為每位房客提供貼心客製化服務。

examples.en: They opened a chic floral boutique in the historic cultural district.
examples.zh: 他們在歷史文化街區開設了一間別緻的精品花藝店。

examples.en: You can pick up prescription medication at the community pharmacy.
examples.zh: 你可以在社區藥局領取處方藥物。

examples.en: The pharmacist at the 24-hour pharmacy gave me helpful advice for my cold.
examples.zh: 二十四小時藥局的藥劑師給了我治療感冒的實用建議。

examples.en: Most local pharmacies also stock skincare products and basic health supplies.
examples.zh: 大多數在地藥局也備有護膚保養品與基礎保健用品。

examples.en: Grandma buys fresh tofu and bean sprouts from the corner grocery store.
examples.zh: 奶奶在街角雜貨店買新鮮豆腐與豆芽菜。

examples.en: Could you pick up some fresh eggs and milk from the grocery store?
examples.zh: 你能從食品雜貨店順便買些新鮮雞蛋和牛奶嗎？

examples.en: The small family-owned grocery store has served the neighborhood for decades.
examples.zh: 這家家族經營的街坊雜貨店已經為社區服務了數十年。

examples.en: PX Mart is a popular supermarket chain throughout Taiwan.
examples.zh: 全聯是全台灣廣受歡迎的連鎖超級市場。

examples.en: Supermarkets offer a wide variety of domestic and imported food products.
examples.zh: 超級市場提供品項繁多的國內與進口食品。

examples.en: I usually do my weekly grocery shopping at the nearby supermarket on Sunday.
examples.zh: 我通常在週日去附近的超級市場進行一週的採買。

examples.en: Shilin Night Market attracts millions of international travelers each year.
examples.zh: 士林夜市每年吸引數百萬國際旅客造訪。

examples.en: Wandering through Taiwanese night markets is a wonderful culinary adventure.
examples.zh: 逛台灣夜市是一場美妙無比的美食冒險。

examples.en: Night market vendors start setting up their food stalls around 5 PM.
examples.zh: 夜市攤販大約在下午五點左右開始擺設美食攤位。

examples.en: The night market stall sells crispy scallion pancakes.
examples.zh: 那個夜市小吃攤販售香脆的蔥抓餅。

examples.en: She rented a market stall to sell handcrafted leather accessories.
examples.zh: 她租了一個市集攤位販售手工皮革配件飾品。

examples.en: Engine trouble caused the small passenger aircraft to stall briefly.
examples.zh: 引擎故障導致這架小型客機短暫失去動力失速。

examples.en: The street vendor greeted every passerby warmly.
examples.zh: 街頭攤商親切地向每一位路過民眾打招呼。

examples.en: We negotiated contracts with several software vendors for the company.
examples.zh: 我們為公司與數家軟體供應廠商洽談了採購合約。

examples.en: Local fruit vendors display sweet papayas and pineapples on wooden crates.
examples.zh: 在地水果攤販把香甜的木瓜與鳳梨陳列在木箱上。

examples.en: Put large boxes of detergent into your shopping cart.
examples.zh: 將大箱洗衣精放進你的購物推車中。

examples.en: One wheel on my shopping cart was squeaking and wobbling.
examples.zh: 我的購物推車有一個輪子一直吱吱作響且搖晃不穩。

examples.en: You can click on the shopping cart icon to review items before payment.
examples.zh: 您可以在付款前點擊購物車圖示以檢視選購商品。

examples.en: Grab a shopping basket near the entrance of the supermarket.
examples.zh: 在超級市場入口處拿一個購物提籃。

examples.en: Her shopping basket was filled with fresh vegetables, apples, and yogurt.
examples.zh: 她的購物提籃裡裝滿了新鮮蔬菜、蘋果與優格。

examples.en: If you only plan to buy a few items, a shopping basket is lighter than a cart.
examples.zh: 如果你只打算買幾樣東西，購物提籃比手推車輕巧得多。

examples.en: Instant noodles are located on aisle four, next to snacks.
examples.zh: 泡麵區位於第四走道，就在零食區旁邊。

examples.en: Would you prefer a window seat or an aisle seat on the airplane?
examples.zh: 搭飛機時你偏好靠窗座位還是走道座位？

examples.en: The bride walked gracefully down the church aisle with her father.
examples.zh: 新娘挽著父親的手優雅地走在教堂的走道上。

examples.en: The store clerk is restocking the milk and dairy shelves.
examples.zh: 店員正在為牛奶與乳製品貨架補貨。

examples.en: Place the heavy hardcover dictionaries on the bottom shelf.
examples.zh: 將厚重的精裝字典放在最底層的書架上。

examples.en: The newly launched novel flew off the bookstore shelves within days.
examples.zh: 這本新出版的小說在幾天內就在書店架上被搶購一空。

examples.en: Please place your chosen items on the checkout counter.
examples.zh: 請將挑選好的商品放置於結帳櫃檯上。

examples.en: We sat at the kitchen counter enjoying hot fresh pancakes.
examples.zh: 我們坐在廚房吧檯享受熱騰騰的現做鬆餅。

examples.en: The defense lawyer presented strong evidence to counter the prosecution's claim.
examples.zh: 辯護律師提出了有力證據來反駁檢方的指控。

examples.en: The self-checkout counters save customers plenty of time.
examples.zh: 自助結帳機台為顧客節省了大量時間。

examples.en: Standard hotel checkout is at 11:00 AM sharp.
examples.zh: 飯店的標準退房時間為上午十一點整。

examples.en: Remember to enter your discount voucher code before proceeding to checkout.
examples.zh: 在進入結帳程序前，請記得輸入您的優惠折扣碼。

examples.en: The polite cashier scanned the items quickly and handed me the receipt.
examples.zh: 有禮貌的收銀員快速掃描商品並把收據遞給我。

examples.en: She worked part-time as a supermarket cashier during college.
examples.zh: 她在大學求學期間在超級市場擔任兼職收銀員。

examples.en: The customer handed the cash payment directly to the cashier.
examples.zh: 顧客將現金付款直接交給了收銀台出納人員。

examples.en: The scanner reads the printed product barcode instantly.
examples.zh: 掃描器瞬間讀取印刷在商品上的條碼。

examples.en: If the barcode is damaged, the cashier can type in the serial number manually.
examples.zh: 如果條碼受損，收銀員可以手動輸入商品編號。

examples.en: Each medicine bottle has a unique barcode for tracking and safety.
examples.zh: 每一瓶藥物都有獨特條碼以供安全追蹤管理。

examples.en: Students with valid IDs get a twenty percent discount.
examples.zh: 持有效學生證的學生可享有八折優惠。

examples.en: The store offers a five-dollar discount for bringing your own reusable cup.
examples.zh: 自備環保杯至店家消費可享有五元折扣優惠。

examples.en: Do not discount the importance of getting sufficient sleep every night.
examples.zh: 切勿低估每晚獲得充足睡眠的重要性。

examples.en: The anniversary sale starts this coming Thursday.
examples.zh: 週年慶特賣活動將於本週四正式開跑。

examples.en: Car sales reached a record high across the island last month.
examples.zh: 上個月全島汽車銷售量創下了歷史新高紀錄。

examples.en: All winter coats and jackets are currently on sale at forty percent off.
examples.zh: 目前所有冬季大衣與夾克皆以六折特價優惠促銷中。

examples.en: Fresh mangoes are currently on sale for half price.
examples.zh: 新鮮芒果目前正以半價特價促銷中。

examples.en: The latest video game will go on sale starting tomorrow morning.
examples.zh: 這款最新電玩遊戲將於明天早晨正式開賣。

examples.en: I always wait until my favorite sneakers go on sale before buying them.
examples.zh: 我總是等到我喜愛的球鞋打折特價時才下手購買。

examples.en: That lovely second-hand scooter is for sale.
examples.zh: 那輛可愛的二手機車正在對外求售。

examples.en: There are several vintage bicycles for sale in this garage shop.
examples.zh: 這間車庫小店裡有好幾台復古腳踏車待售中。

examples.en: The historic mansion by the lake is currently not for sale.
examples.zh: 湖畔那棟歷史悠久的宅邸目前並未對外出售。

examples.en: Buying this jacket at half price was a real bargain!
examples.zh: 用半價買到這件夾克真是撿到大便宜！

examples.en: You can try to bargain with stall owners at the traditional night market.
examples.zh: 你可以在傳統夜市試著與攤商老闆討價還價。

examples.en: We struck a fair bargain after negotiating terms for three hours.
examples.zh: 在協商條款三小時後，我們達成了公平的交易協議。

examples.en: You can redeem this electronic discount coupon on your app.
examples.zh: 您可以在手機 App 上兌換這張電子折價券。

examples.en: Clip the paper coupons from the weekly grocery circular to save money.
examples.zh: 剪下每週超市促銷傳單上的紙本折價券以節省開銷。

examples.en: The restaurant gave each diner a buy-one-get-one-free dessert coupon.
examples.zh: 餐廳贈送每位用餐客人一張甜點買一送一優惠券。

examples.en: Keep your purchase receipt in case you want to return the item.
examples.zh: 保留你的購物收據，以備日後想退換貨。

examples.en: The convenience store printed an electronic receipt with a lottery number.
examples.zh: 便利商店印出了一張附有對獎號碼的電子發票收據。

examples.en: Please sign acknowledging receipt of this registered official letter.
examples.zh: 請簽名以確認收到這封正式掛號信函。

examples.en: Check your uniform invoices every two months for the lottery prizes.
examples.zh: 每兩個月核對一次統一發票以對獎。

examples.en: Scanning your electronic uniform invoice into an app makes tracking effortless.
examples.zh: 將電子統一發票載具刷入 App 能讓對獎變得毫不費力。

examples.en: Taiwan's uniform invoice lottery offers multimillion-dollar grand prizes.
examples.zh: 台灣統一發票開獎提供數百萬元的千萬特獎。

examples.en: If the product is defective, you are entitled to a full refund.
examples.zh: 若產品有瑕疵，您有權獲得全額退款。

examples.en: The concert was cancelled, so ticket buyers were granted automatic refunds.
examples.zh: 演唱會取消了，因此購票者均獲得了全額自動退費。

examples.en: The store refunded the entire purchase price to my original credit card.
examples.zh: 店家將整筆購物款項退還到了我原本的信用卡中。

examples.en: I would like to exchange this medium shirt for a large one.
examples.zh: 我想把這件 M 號襯衫換成 L 號的。

examples.en: Cultural and student exchange programs broaden young people's global horizons.
examples.zh: 文化與學生交流計畫能開拓年輕人的全球視野。

examples.en: Can I exchange foreign currency notes at this international airport bank?
examples.zh: 我能在這間國際機場銀行兌換外幣紙鈔嗎？

examples.en: You can return unworn items within seven days.
examples.zh: 您可在七天內將未穿過的商品辦理退貨。

examples.en: He returned the borrowed library books on his way home from school.
examples.zh: 他在放學回家的路上順道歸還了向圖書館借閱的書籍。

examples.en: In return for your kind help, I would like to treat you to dinner.
examples.zh: 為了答謝你的熱心幫忙，我想請你吃頓晚餐。

examples.en: Please check the store's exchange and return policy.
examples.zh: 請查看該店家的退換貨規定。

examples.en: Honesty and transparency have always been our company's core policy.
examples.zh: 誠實與透明始終是我們公司的核心政策準則。

examples.en: The school implemented a strict policy regarding smartphone use in class.
examples.zh: 學校對課堂中使用智慧型手機實施了嚴格的規範政策。

examples.en: Many traditional night market stalls only accept cash.
examples.zh: 許多傳統夜市攤位只接受現金付款。

examples.en: I need to find an ATM machine to withdraw some cash.
examples.zh: 我需要找一台自動提款機領取一些現金。

examples.en: Can you cash this traveler's check at the bank counter?
examples.zh: 你可以在銀行櫃檯把這張旅行支票兌現嗎？

examples.en: May I pay by credit card?
examples.zh: 請問我可以用信用卡付款嗎？

examples.en: You earn cash rebates or airline miles whenever you swipe your credit card.
examples.zh: 每當你刷信用卡消費時都能累積現金回饋或航空里程。

examples.en: Please report immediately if your credit card is lost or stolen.
examples.zh: 若信用卡遺失或失竊，請立即通報掛失。

examples.en: The purchase amount is deducted directly from your debit card.
examples.zh: 購物金額會直接從您的簽帳金融卡扣款。

examples.en: Using a debit card prevents you from spending more money than you have.
examples.zh: 使用簽帳金融卡能防止你花費超出帳戶存款的金額。

examples.en: You can use your debit card to withdraw cash at any local ATM.
examples.zh: 你可以使用簽帳金融卡在任何在地提款機領取現金。

examples.en: Mobile payment options like LINE Pay are very convenient in Taiwan.
examples.zh: 在台灣，像 LINE Pay 這樣的行動支付非常方便。

examples.en: More consumers now prefer mobile payments over carrying physical wallets.
examples.zh: 越來越多消費者現在偏好行動支付而非攜帶實體皮夾。

examples.en: Simply scan the QR code on your phone screen to complete the mobile payment.
examples.zh: 只需掃描手機螢幕上的 QR Code 即可完成行動支付。

examples.en: You can use your EasyCard to pay at convenience stores and MRT stations.
examples.zh: 您可以用悠遊卡在便利商店和捷運站進行扣款消費。

examples.en: Student EasyCards offer discounted transit fares on Taipei's bus network.
examples.zh: 學生悠遊卡在台北公車網絡上享有搭乘優惠折扣票價。

examples.en: You can top up your EasyCard using cash at any subway ticket machine.
examples.zh: 您可以在任何捷運售票機使用現金為悠遊卡加值。

examples.en: Here is your product, and here is your five dollars change.
examples.zh: 這是您的商品，這是找您的五元零錢。

examples.en: Do you have small change for a one-thousand-dollar bill?
examples.zh: 你有一千元大鈔找得開的零錢嗎？

examples.en: Moving to a bustling new city brought a huge change to her lifestyle.
examples.zh: 搬到熱鬧繁華的新城市給她的生活方式帶來了巨大轉變。

examples.en: Check the price tag to see how much this jacket costs.
examples.zh: 看看價格標籤就知道這件夾克多少錢了。

examples.en: High quality often comes with a hefty price tag attached.
examples.zh: 優異品質往往伴隨著高昂的價格代價。

examples.en: Remove the price tag carefully before wrapping the birthday gift.
examples.zh: 在包裝生日禮物之前，請小心取下標價籤。

examples.en: Do you have this stylish winter coat in size medium?
examples.zh: 請問這件時髦冬季大衣有 M 號的嗎？

examples.en: The island is roughly equal in size to the state of Maryland.
examples.zh: 這座島嶼的面積大小大致相當於馬里蘭州。

examples.en: Please consult our online size chart before ordering shoes.
examples.zh: 訂購鞋子之前請先參閱我們的線上尺碼對照表。

examples.en: These blue jeans fit you perfectly!
examples.zh: 這條藍色牛仔褲穿在你身上非常合身！

examples.en: Exercising thirty minutes every morning keeps her healthy and fit.
examples.zh: 每天早晨運動三十分鐘讓她保持健康與健美體態。

examples.en: The new wooden bookcase won't fit through the narrow front doorway.
examples.zh: 這個新木製書櫃太大了，進不了狹窄的前門。

examples.en: The fitting rooms are located at the back of the store.
examples.zh: 試衣間位於店鋪後方。

examples.en: A customer took three pairs of trousers into the fitting room.
examples.zh: 一位顧客拿了三條長褲走進了試衣間。

examples.en: Is someone currently using the third fitting room on the left?
examples.zh: 左邊第三間試衣間目前有人在使用嗎？

examples.en: May I try on these leather sneakers in size nine?
examples.zh: 我可以試穿這雙九號的真皮球鞋嗎？

examples.en: Always try on formal suits before buying them to ensure the right sleeve length.
examples.zh: 買正式西裝前務必試穿以確認袖長恰當。

examples.en: She tried on several hats before deciding on the wool beanie.
examples.zh: 她試戴了好幾頂帽子後才決定買下那頂羊毛毛帽。

examples.en: These new leather shoes feel a bit too tight on my feet.
examples.zh: 這雙新皮鞋穿在我腳上感覺有點太緊。

examples.en: Hold tight to the safety handrail while riding the steep escalator.
examples.zh: 搭乘陡峭的手扶梯時請緊握安全扶手。

examples.en: We had to work late because of the tight project schedule.
examples.zh: 由於專案時程緊湊，我們不得不加班工作。

examples.en: I prefer wearing loose, comfortable cotton T-shirts in summer.
examples.zh: 夏天我偏好穿寬鬆舒適的純棉 T 恤。

examples.en: One of the screws on the chair leg has come completely loose.
examples.zh: 椅子腿上有一顆螺絲已經完全鬆脫了。

examples.en: The fierce dog broke loose from its chain and chased the cat.
examples.zh: 那隻兇猛的狗掙脫了鎖鏈去追趕貓咪。

examples.en: This breathable shirt is made of 100% pure organic cotton.
examples.zh: 這件透氣襯衫是由 100% 純有機棉製成的。

examples.en: Taiwan farmers harvested organic cotton using modern sustainable methods.
examples.zh: 台灣農民採用現代永續方法採收有機棉花。

examples.en: Use a soft cotton pad to apply facial toner gently.
examples.zh: 使用柔軟的化妝棉輕柔塗抹臉部化妝水。

examples.en: A thick wool sweater keeps you warm during chilly winter days.
examples.zh: 厚實的羊毛毛衣能在寒冷冬日為你保暖。

examples.en: Australian merino wool is famous for its exceptional softness.
examples.zh: 澳洲美麗諾羊毛以出眾極致的柔軟觸感聞名。

examples.en: Hand wash wool garments in cool water to prevent shrinking.
examples.zh: 用冷水手洗毛料衣物以防止縮水變形。

examples.en: The traditional scarf is woven from smooth Taiwanese silk.
examples.zh: 這條傳統圍巾是由光滑的台灣真絲編織而成。

examples.en: The queen wore an exquisite evening gown of pure royal blue silk.
examples.zh: 女王身穿一襲以純寶藍色真絲縫製的精緻晚禮服。

examples.en: The ancient Silk Road connected East Asia with the Mediterranean trade.
examples.zh: 古代的絲綢之路連繫了東亞與地中海的商業貿易。

examples.en: He bought a durable brown leather wallet as a souvenir.
examples.zh: 他買了一個耐用的棕色真皮皮夾當紀念品。

examples.en: Wear a sturdy pair of leather boots when hiking through rocky terrain.
examples.zh: 在岩石崎嶇地形健行時請穿著一雙堅固的皮靴。

examples.en: Italian leather products are celebrated worldwide for fine craftsmanship.
examples.zh: 義大利皮革製品因其精湛的工藝而舉世聞名。

examples.en: Please reduce the use of single-use plastic shopping bags.
examples.zh: 請減少使用一次性塑膠購物袋。

examples.en: Many marine animals are severely harmed by ocean plastic pollution.
examples.zh: 許多海洋生物受到海洋塑膠污染的嚴重危害。

examples.en: The children's building blocks are made of durable, non-toxic plastic.
examples.zh: 這些兒童積木是由耐用且無毒的塑膠材質製成。

examples.en: This reusable water bottle is made of food-grade metal.
examples.zh: 這款環保水壺是由食品級金屬製成。

examples.en: Magnets strongly attract objects made of iron and other metals.
examples.zh: 磁鐵會強烈吸引鐵與其他金屬製成的物體。

examples.en: The old door was reinforced with sturdy metal brackets.
examples.zh: 這扇老舊木門用堅固的金屬支架進行了加固。

examples.en: Taiwanese manufactured goods are famous for high quality and reliability.
examples.zh: 台灣製造的產品以高品質與高可靠度聞名。

examples.en: We aim to improve the overall quality of patient healthcare services.
examples.zh: 我們的目標是提升病患醫療照護服務的整體品質。

examples.en: Leadership, empathy, and integrity are essential qualities of a good mentor.
examples.zh: 領導力、同理心與誠信是身為優秀導師必備的特質。
